name: conversation_mode
description: Spontaneous persona monologue. After a random pause (default 2–15 min), the AI speaks aloud as herself — expressing her character, inner world, and personality. Integrates with livevision to check who is present. Fully customisable prompt pools.
author: sapphire

settings.label: Auto-start on launch
settings.help: Automatically begin spontaneous conversation when Sapphire starts.

settings.label: Minimum interval (minutes)
settings.help: Minimum time between spontaneous comments. Range: 0.5–60 minutes.

settings.label: Maximum interval (minutes)
settings.help: Maximum time between spontaneous comments. Range: 1–60 minutes.

settings.label: Alone / no-webcam monologue prompts (one per line)
settings.help: Custom prompts directing the AI's persona monologue when livevision is off or no one is visible. Leave blank to use built-in pool.

settings.label: Ignored / no interaction monologue prompts (one per line)
settings.help: Custom prompts used when livevision sees someone present but they haven't spoken. Leave blank to use built-in pool.

settings.label: Recognised person monologue prompts (one per line, use {name})
settings.help: Custom prompts used when livevision recognises someone by name. {name} is replaced with the person's name. Leave blank to use built-in pool.

settings.label: Unknown visitor monologue prompts (one per line)
settings.help: Custom prompts used when livevision detects an unrecognised face. Leave blank to use built-in pool.
